stage.note: GitLab IPO'd on NASDAQ (GTLB) in October 2021. The hosted runners/compute minutes product evaluated here (GitLab.com CI) is a feature of the core GitLab.com SaaS product, not a separately funded spinout; this card is about the GitLab.com hosted CI runner feature, whose parent company GitLab Inc. is public. YC hint confirmed: YC directory lists 'GitLab' with the same website domain (gitlab.com) as this provider; YC page did not expose batch text via static fetch but GitLab is widely documented (e.g. company history, press) as YC Winter 2015 (W15) alumnus.

total_funding_usd.basis: Widely reported aggregate (Crunchbase/press) of GitLab's pre-IPO venture rounds (seed through Series E, 2015-2019) prior to its October 2021 IPO; not independently re-verified line-by-line in this pass.

note: This card covers GitLab.com's hosted CI runners / compute minutes feature (macOS, Windows, Linux x86/Arm64/GPU), part of the core GitLab.com SaaS product, not a standalone company. GitLab Inc. (ticker GTLB) is a public company on NASDAQ since its October 2021 IPO; it was a Y Combinator company (Winter 2015 batch, per YC's own listing and widely documented company history), making its funding stage 'public' (last priced private round was pre-IPO; the IPO supersedes stage classification). Total pre-IPO funding (~$436M) and revenue (FY2026 ARR > $1B) are from aggregator/press sources and were not independently reconciled against a full SEC filing in this pass due to the 15-minute time budget.
